_comment: SAM's copy of the hpc-scheduling-tools capacities.json, consumed in-process by the /api/v1/fairshare endpoint via $HPC_SCHED_CAPACITIES. The plugin repo (NCAR/hpc-scheduling-tools) is the source of truth for these constants; keep this in sync on a hardware change. N_cpu/N_gpu are operator-tunable and must track the scheduler's fairshare_usage_res formula, which is why they live here (mounted as a ConfigMap in prod, editable without an image rebuild) rather than baked into the wheel.

Casper._comment: Roughly the number of CPU cores and GPGPUs allocated against CPU- and GPU- project allocations, respectively.
